{{Conjecture|legends}}
A continuous '''war''' was waged between the<ref name="CSWE Hyabb">{{CSWECite|II|69|Hyabb}}</ref> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="TEA Hyabb Twith">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Hyabb system/Legends|Hyabb system]] and [[Twith system/Legends|Twith system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planets]]<ref name="CSWE Hyabb" /><ref name="CSWE Twith">{{CSWECite|III|270|Twith}}</ref> [[Hyabb]] and [[Twith]]. The conflict lasted almost since the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|foundation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CSWE Hyabb" /> and was still being waged [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref> [[4050 BBY]].<ref name="4000 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that the conflict between [[Hyabb]] and [[Twith]] was still being waged "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to [[Arca Jeth]] becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] [[Gender/Legends|he]] participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the Hyabb–Twith war must have been ongoing decades prior to that date.</ref>
